semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides specialized equipment for handling heavy objects in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Kohan Kogyo specializes in equipment designed for the transport of heavy objects, such as silicon ingots, within semiconductor manufacturing facilities. Their air porter technology minimizes contact with floors, reducing dust and debris, which is critical in cleanroom environments.
capabilities: Air porter technology for heavy object transport
technical_expertise: Load handling and logistics in cleanroom environments
